reasoning: This is an abstract UI chrome glyph (an X-box with an outward arrow) with no clear real-world object meaning. In a to-do list it looks like a cancelled checkbox rather than a task subject, and almost any real task about cancelling, closing, or exporting is better served by an icon of the thing being cancelled or exported.
